description: This file defines the interface for son_actions class which implements various station and client management actions in the prplMesh network controller, including blocking, unblocking, steering, disconnecting clients, handling dead radios/stations, and sending messages to agents.

classes.name: son::son_actions
classes.description: A class providing static methods for managing station and client actions, including connection handling, steering, blocking, unblocking, messaging, and handling radio/station failures in the networking controller.

methods.name: handle_completed_connection
methods.description: Handles post-connection procedures for a device identified by client_mac.

methods.name: add_station_to_default_location
methods.description: Adds a station to the default location in the device database.

methods.name: unblock_sta
methods.description: Removes a block on a station identified by its MAC address.

methods.name: block_sta
methods.description: Blocks a station from associating with BSSes with the same SSID as the specified BSSID for a specified duration.

methods.name: steer_sta
methods.description: Steers a station to a chosen host AP, possibly disassociating it first.

methods.name: disconnect_client
methods.description: Disconnects a client from the network with specified reason and source.

methods.name: set_radio_active
methods.description: Activates or deactivates a radio interface.

methods.name: send_cli_debug_message
methods.description: Sends a debug message via CLI to the management interface.

methods.name: handle_dead_radio
methods.description: Handles a radio interface that is reported as dead or non-responsive.

methods.name: handle_dead_station
methods.description: Handles a station that is reported as dead or non-responsive.

methods.name: validate_beacon_measurement_report
methods.description: Validates a beacon measurement report for a station and BSSID.

methods.name: has_matching_operating_class
methods.description: Checks whether the radio capabilities match the BSS information's operating class.

methods.name: send_cmdu_to_agent
methods.description: Sends a CMSDU message to a specified agent identified by MAC address.

methods.name: send_ap_config_renew_msg
methods.description: Sends an AP configuration renewal message.

methods.name: send_topology_query_msg
methods.description: Sends a topology query message to an agent.

methods.name: start_btm_request_task
methods.description: Initiates a BSS Transition Management request task with specified parameters.

methods.name: send_client_association_control
methods.description: Sends a client association control message to an agent.

methods.name: handle_agent_ap_mld_configuration_tlv
methods.description: Handles an MLD configuration TLV received from an agent.
